decisions.reason: The firm presents the citrus harvesting crate as a flagship. It builds directly on its agricultural crate expertise and in-house engineering, so management can interpret early results and refine it.
Foldable large containers are core to the firm's returnable packaging knowledge. The line has several models and its own page, which signals commitment and strong absorptive capacity.
Stackable plastic crates sit at the heart of the firm's existing competence. In-house development lets it learn from market feedback and extend the line.
Rackable pallets build on the firm's established pallet engineering and manufacturing knowledge. This makes the line easy to assimilate and improve.
Spill-retention pallets are slightly further from logistics packaging, toward safety and environmental equipment. They still rely on related plastic pallet know-how, and the line has its own page.

A pallet with load retainers is a close extension of the firm's pallet and handling-accessory expertise. It has a dedicated page, though as a single product it is somewhat more exposed to being dropped.
